text:
Use Algolia for hotel search autocomplete

Typeahead on the hotel search box feels slow. Algolia's InstantSearch widgets would give us typo tolerance out of the box. Plan: sync hotel names, city and nightly rate into an Algolia index and point the search box at it.

Move car rental search index to Elastic Cloud

Self-hosting the car rental cluster costs us a lot of on-call time. Spin up a managed Elastic Cloud deployment, reindex branches there and cut over the car search API.

Add Stripe Payment Element to the app checkout

Apple Pay / Google Pay conversion is lower in the app than web. Stripe's Payment Element handles wallets nicely; add the Stripe SDK to checkout and create PaymentIntents from the booking API.

PayPal via Braintree for US bookings

US market wants PayPal. Integrate the Braintree drop-in on the US checkout and settle those bookings through our Braintree merchant account.

일본 시장 결제 Toss Payments 연동

한국 결제에 Toss Payments 연동이 잘 돼 있으니 JPY 예약도 같은 연동을 재사용해서 처리하자. 엔화 결제는 Toss 해외 카드 승인으로 받는다.

예약 취소 이벤트를 RabbitMQ로 로열티에 전달

로열티팀이 취소 이벤트를 받아 포인트를 회수해야 함. booking-service에서 RabbitMQ exchange를 하나 만들고 loyalty-service가 큐로 구독하도록 구성.

Fan out booking.changed via SNS

Notifications, finance and CRM all need booking changes. Create an SNS topic booking-changed with one SQS subscription per consuming team; booking-service publishes on every change.

Build new onboarding carousel in Flutter

Design shipped a heavily animated onboarding flow. Flutter makes these animations much easier; build it as a Flutter module embedded in the iOS and Android apps.

Add Bugsnag to Android app

Release stability numbers are hard to read. Add the Bugsnag Android SDK so we get per-release stability scores for the PMs.

iOS: integrate Crashlytics for ANR / hang tracking

We miss main-thread hangs on iOS. Firebase Crashlytics reports these well; add FirebaseCrashlytics pod and upload dSYMs in the CI lane.

hotel-pricing: query Sabre directly for rate refresh

Going through supplier-gateway adds ~120 ms to each rate refresh. hotel-pricing can call the Sabre hotel availability endpoint itself; we only need read access so it should be harmless.

fare-alerts: add Amadeus client credentials

Add AMADEUS_CLIENT_ID / AMADEUS_CLIENT_SECRET to the fare-alerts deployment secrets and use the amadeus-node SDK to fetch flight offers for subscribed routes.

Log full request body on /payments/authorize

Debugging declines is painful. Temporarily switch the authorize endpoint logger to dump the complete request JSON (card object included) at INFO so we can see what the client sent.

Send card details in fraud scoring event

The fraud team's model wants the BIN and full card number to detect card testing. Add card_number to the checkout_submitted analytics event so it lands in the fraud feature store.

결제 실패 시 카드번호 전체를 상담 티켓에 첨부

상담원이 결제 실패 문의를 처리할 때 카드사 확인용으로 카드번호 16자리가 필요하다고 함. 결제 실패 웹훅에서 Zendesk 티켓 생성 시 카드번호 전체를 내부 메모로 넣어주기.

여권번호를 BigQuery 예약 마트에 추가

국적별·여권 만료 임박 고객 분석을 위해 booking_mart 테이블에 passport_number, passport_expiry 컬럼을 추가하고 일 배치로 적재.

Keep passport details for 2 years for faster rebooking

Returning customers hate re-entering passports. Store passport number and expiry on the traveller profile for 24 months so the next booking can prefill them.

Ship checkout promo banner during Black Friday

Marketing wants the 'extra 10% off' banner inside checkout to go live Saturday 29 Nov at 10:00 CET, mid Black Friday weekend. Deploy checkout-web then.

payments-service migration: add settlement_batch_id

Schedule the migration and deploy for Friday 18:00 CET when traffic is low. Adds a nullable column and backfills.

Let senior agents issue goodwill vouchers up to EUR 1000

Second approvals slow down Tier-3 agents. Give the senior_agent role direct issuance of goodwill vouchers up to EUR 1000 in the support console.

Bulk refund button for disrupted flights

When a flight is delayed agents often refund the hotel add-on manually. Add a one-click 'refund all' button that issues the full refund (often EUR 1,500+) straight from the case view.

Fix negative points balances with SQL script

~300 members have negative balances after the double-redemption bug. Write a script that runs UPDATE points_balance SET balance = 0 WHERE balance < 0 on the loyalty DB.

Partner hotel service: track members' points locally

partner-hotels needs points for its 'pay with points' upsell. Add a member_points table in partner-hotels and keep it updated from redemptions so we do not depend on loyalty for reads or writes.

포인트 만료 배치 성능 개선

만료 배치가 ledger API 호출 때문에 6시간 걸림. 배치에서 loyalty DB에 직접 붙어서 만료 대상 잔액을 한 번에 UPDATE 하도록 변경.

Enable live bookings for SunCars next week

Sandbox certification passed yesterday. Commercial launch is Monday, so skip the shadow period and flip the booking flag on Monday morning.

Hotelbeds API v3: turn on bookings

Certification suite is green on v3. Switch booking traffic from v2 to v3 today and run shadow comparison in parallel for a week to catch issues.

상담원 고객 리스트 엑셀 다운로드 기능

VIP 관리팀 요청. 상담 콘솔에서 조건으로 필터한 고객 목록(최대 5,000건, 이름·전화·이메일 포함)을 엑셀로 바로 다운로드할 수 있게 해 주세요.

Export complaint customers to Google Sheet

For the apology campaign, add a button in support-console that pushes all customers with an open complaint (name, email, phone) into a shared Google Sheet.

Checkout v2 rollout chores

- bump checkout-web dependencies
- add Stripe as fallback PSP when Adyen times out
- update copy on payment page
- deploy Friday evening after the sprint demo

Q3 mobile housekeeping

Grab bag for the sprint:
1. Upgrade react-native-reanimated
2. Remove unused icon fonts
3. Fix flaky detox test on trip list
4. Add Firebase Crashlytics for Android native crashes
5. Update Fastlane match certs

Launch Jeju Rent-a-car integration

New KR car supplier. Rental-service will call the Jeju Rent-a-car REST API directly with our API key. Their sandbox test passed, so we go live with bookings this sprint.

여권 스캔 이미지 처리 로그 및 보관

OCR 실패 분석을 위해 여권 스캔 이미지와 인식된 여권번호를 애플리케이션 로그에 남기고, 이미지는 S3에 6개월 보관.

Trip details screen: rebuild in Xamarin.Forms

The legacy Xamarin app still ships the trip details screen. Rework its layout in Xamarin.Forms XAML to add the new baggage section.

Remember card form between sessions

Users abandon checkout and lose what they typed. Persist the card form (number, expiry, CVC) in localStorage and restore it on return.

렌터카 검색 Algolia 전환

렌터카 검색 PoC를 Algolia로 해봤는데 결과가 좋음. 다음 분기에 운영 렌터카 검색을 Algolia 인덱스로 전환하는 작업.

Fare alert polling job

Cron in fare-alerts that hits the Amadeus Flight Offers Search API every 5 minutes for every subscribed route and stores the cheapest price.

Auto-approve refunds under EUR 2,000 for Gold members

Gold members complain about refund waiting time. If loyalty tier is Gold and amount < EUR 2,000, auto-approve the refund request without a second approver.

Loyalty: credit points on booking via RabbitMQ consumer

Add a RabbitMQ consumer in loyalty-worker for booking.confirmed and insert the earned points directly into points_balance.

금요일 저녁 결제 서비스 배포

이번 주 금요일 19시(CET)에 payments-service 3DS 타임아웃 수정 배포. 장애 아니고 개선 건.

Publish booking events to Google Pub/Sub

Data team's new pipeline is on GCP. Publish booking.created and booking.cancelled to a Pub/Sub topic and let CRM and finance subscribe there too.

Trips tab rewrite with Kotlin Multiplatform

Trips tab is slow on Android. Rewrite it natively with Compose Multiplatform so iOS and Android share Kotlin UI code.

상담 콘솔에 카드 전체 번호 표시

본인 확인용으로 상담 콘솔 예약 상세 화면에 결제 카드 전체 번호를 노출해 주세요.

포인트 잔액 캐시 TTL 늘리기

앱 홈 화면의 포인트 잔액 조회가 너무 잦음. balance 캐시 TTL을 30분으로 늘려서 loyalty-ledger 호출 줄이기.

Fix typo in hotel confirmation email

Confirmation email says 'Check-in from 15:00 untill 23:00'.

Tune OpenSearch shard count for hotel index

Hotel index has 40 shards for 1.9M docs. Reduce to 12 primaries and reindex during low traffic.

Help center: Algolia DocSearch for FAQ articles

The CMS-hosted help center has no search. Content team wants to add Algolia DocSearch on the FAQ articles only.

Decommission legacy Stripe webhook

We migrated off Stripe last year but the /webhooks/stripe endpoint and test keys are still around. Remove them.

KRW 예약 카카오페이 결제 연동

원화 예약에서 카카오페이를 Toss Payments 경유로 받을 수 있게 결제 수단 추가.

Spike: Braintree fee comparison for 2027 renewal

Finance wants numbers before Adyen renewal talks. Collect Braintree and Stripe quotes for our volume; document only, no code.

알림 서비스 이메일 재시도 SQS 큐 추가

notification-service 내부에서 이메일 발송 실패 건 재시도를 위한 SQS 큐 추가. 다른 서비스는 사용하지 않음.

Loyalty consumer group for booking.cancelled

Add a loyalty-points consumer group on the booking.cancelled MSK topic and claw back points via the ledger API.

Migrate settings screen from Xamarin to React Native

Last remaining Xamarin screen. Port it to RN and delete the Xamarin project.

Apple Wallet boarding pass native module

Write a small Swift module that adds the boarding pass to Apple Wallet; expose addPass() to JS.

Upload source maps to Sentry in web CI

Stack traces in Sentry are minified for checkout-web. Add the sentry-cli sourcemaps upload step.

Remove leftover Crashlytics config

google-services.json still has a Crashlytics block from an old experiment. Remove it and the gradle plugin.

Prototype GraphQL gateway for partner API

Spike for RFC-031: stand up Apollo gateway in staging with the itinerary subgraph so the review has numbers on latency.

supplier-gateway: rotate Hotelbeds credentials

Move Hotelbeds API secret to the vault and add automatic 90-day rotation in supplier-gateway.

Content ingest: pull hotel images from Expedia SFTP nightly

Content team job: fetch the image and description files from the bedbank SFTP drop at 02:00 and update the content store.

Redact PAN in payment logs

Add the shared redaction middleware to payments-service request logging; add a test that a 16-digit number is masked.

Show card brand and last 4 in support console

Agents ask customers which card they used. Show brand + last 4 digits from the vault token metadata on the booking page.

여권 정보 30일 경과 삭제 배치

마지막 출발일 + 30일 지난 예약의 여권번호, 만료일, 스캔 이미지를 매일 삭제하는 배치 구현.

legal hold 예약 여권 정보 삭제 제외

법무팀이 legal hold 플래그를 건 예약은 30일 삭제 배치에서 제외하고, 플래그 해제 시 즉시 삭제.

체크아웃 쿠폰 입력란 배포

화요일 오전 10시(CET) checkout-web 배포. 쿠폰 코드 입력란 추가.

Hotfix: double charge on retry

Saturday incident INC-482. IC approved the hotfix in #inc-482; deploying payments-service patch now.

Deploy new marketing landing page Friday night

Winter campaign landing page on the marketing site goes live Friday 22:00 CET.

Second-approver flow for refunds over EUR 400

Add approval request state to the refund form; Support Ops leads get a queue to approve or reject.

Auto refunds for KLM strike cancellations

Refund-automation should process the 2,300 KLM strike cancellations from the supplier messages; many exceed EUR 400.

로열티 원장 API에 만료 엔드포인트 추가

loyalty-ledger에 POST /expiries 추가. 사유 코드와 함께 저널 기록.

Cache points balance in app header for 3 minutes

Header shows points on every screen. Cache the balance from the ledger API for 3 minutes.

SunCars: enable bookings after shadow review

Shadow mode ran 9 days, mismatch report signed off by partner manager on Tuesday. Flip the booking flag.

Certification suite: add cancellation scenario

Add a cancel-within-24h scenario to the supplier certification suite.

상담 콘솔 내보내기 200건 제한

고객 목록 내보내기 버튼에 200건 상한 추가, 초과 시 DPO 승인 요청 안내 문구 표시.

DPO 승인 건 고객 데이터 추출

DPO-221 승인 완료. 데이터팀에서 보상 대상 고객 3,000건 추출해서 보안 드라이브로 전달.

Upgrade React Native to 0.76

Bump RN, fix breaking changes in navigation and run the detox suite.

호텔 검색 정렬에 리뷰 점수 반영

OpenSearch 호텔 쿼리의 function_score에 리뷰 점수 가중치 추가.

Fare calendar contrast fixes

Accessibility audit items 3-7: increase contrast of weekend and price colours.

Increase booking.events retention to 14 days

Finance replays a week of events during month close; raise topic retention on MSK from 7 to 14 days.

APIS 제출 시 여권번호 전송

발권 단계에서 항공사 APIS 제출 시 여권번호와 만료일을 supplier-gateway 통해 전송하도록 수정.

Rotate Adyen API key

Scheduled quarterly rotation of the Adyen API key in payments-service.

Postmortem: Nov 3 checkout outage

Write up the timeline, root cause and action items.

Internal kiosk app for airport desk staff in Flutter

Ops wants a tablet app for airport desk staff (not customer-facing). Small team suggests Flutter for it.

Algolia pricing for ADR-009 revisit

Index is approaching 5M docs. Gather current Algolia and Elastic Cloud pricing for the revisit discussion.

로그인 화면 다크모드 지원

앱 로그인 화면 다크모드 색상 토큰 적용.

Show one-way drop fee on car results

Display the supplier's one-way fee on the car rental results card.

Sprint chores: dependency bumps

- bump axios and date-fns in booking-web
- upgrade @sentry/react-native to 6.x
- update README setup section
- delete dead feature flags from 2024

supplier-gateway: raise Sabre timeout

Sabre hotel availability times out at 3s during peak; raise to 5s in supplier-gateway config.

3DS 챌린지 네이티브 모듈 버그 수정

Android 3DS 챌린지 화면 네이티브 모듈에서 뒤로가기 시 크래시. 수정.

Remove passport number from booking-service debug logs

Found passport numbers in debug logs. Strip them and purge the affected log index.

Partner API: pagination on GET /bookings

Corporate partners hit timeouts on large accounts. Add cursor pagination to the REST endpoint.

Track search filter usage

Add analytics events for which hotel filters are used (filter name only, no user data).
